requirements.title: Voice Audio Ingestion & Format Handling
requirements.description: Browser MediaRecorder audio capture (<10MB, <60s duration, WebM/WAV containers)
requirements.verification_evidence: Upload size >10MB returns 413, corrupted headers return 400, WebM transcodes to 16kHz PCM WAV.

requirements.title: Speech-to-Text Transcription (Gnani Prisma)
requirements.description: Gnani Prisma STT integration (vachana.ai STT v3) with indic-auto / hi-IN and codemix formatting
requirements.verification_evidence: Prisma live API transcribes audio in ~498ms RTT with codemix formatting preserving English brands.

requirements.title: Transcript Normalization & Synonym Mapping
requirements.description: Unicode normalization, punctuation stripping, phonetic colloquial synonym mapping, preserving raw and normalized
requirements.verification_evidence: Normalized transcripts resolve 'aata'->'atta', 'cheeni'->'sugar', preserving raw input.

requirements.title: Multi-Strategy Product Matching
requirements.description: Exact name match, exact alias match, RapidFuzz fuzzy match, ambiguity detection triggering NEEDS_CLARIFICATION
requirements.verification_evidence: 93.5% product identification accuracy across 30 starter pack benchmarks; ambiguity correctly identified for generic 'doodh'.

requirements.title: Quantity & Packaging Unit Resolution
requirements.description: Standard metric (kg, g, L, ml) and vernacular (aadha kilo, pao bhar, packet) with package integrity rule
requirements.verification_evidence: 93.5% quantity extraction accuracy; fractional requests for fixed-package SKUs (250g of 1kg besan) trigger clarification.

requirements.title: Conversational Intent & State Machine
requirements.verification_evidence: 5/5 multi-turn scenarios passed 100% verifying state transitions across turns.

requirements.title: Conversational Cart Modifications
requirements.description: Quantity override ('nahi aadha kilo kar do'), item removal ('Maggi hata do'), price inquiry, clear cart
requirements.verification_evidence: Quantity replacement and removal verified in CONV001 and CONV002; total recalculated authoritative.

requirements.title: Authoritative Inventory & Price Verification
requirements.description: Live stock checks, partial stock explanation, authoritative pricing strictly from products.price_inr
requirements.verification_evidence: 0 oversell boundary violations; prices computed strictly via database; partial stock explained when requested > available.

requirements.title: Atomic Two-Phase Order Confirmation
requirements.description: Customer confirms pending order (0 stock deducted); merchant acceptance executes row lock & decrements stock
requirements.verification_evidence: PostgreSQL 16.6 concurrency test: 2 simultaneous orders on 1 unit results in exactly 1 success (200) and 1 conflict (409).

requirements.title: Spoken Feedback via Gnani Timbre TTS
requirements.description: Conversational Hindi speech feedback; graceful fallback on TTS error without losing cart turn
requirements.verification_evidence: Timbre synthesizes WAV audio in ~1.38s; TTS network timeout sets audio_status='failed' and returns 200 with cart preserved.

requirements.title: Shopkeeper Operations Interface
requirements.description: Merchant JWT auth, order feed, acceptance, rejection (0 stock), preparation, completion, cancellation with restock
requirements.verification_evidence: Full state progression verified; rejection touches 0 stock; cancellation restores stock with audit row.

requirements.title: Latency Targets (Voice Turn <= 4s Median, <= 10s p95)
requirements.description: Prisma STT <=1500ms, Engine <=250ms, Timbre <=1500ms, Total <=4000ms median

requirements.title: Zero Overselling & Transaction Integrity
requirements.description: 0 oversell boundary violations, 0 price calculation errors, duplicate idempotency enforcement
requirements.verification_evidence: PostgreSQL row locks SELECT FOR UPDATE eliminate race conditions; final inventory exactly 0.000.

requirements.title: Security & Credential Isolation
requirements.description: Zero secrets exposed to frontend, 401 on protected endpoints, customer-merchant boundary enforcement
requirements.verification_evidence: 10 protected endpoints reject unauthenticated calls with 401; zero NEXT_PUBLIC server secrets in frontend.
